**2. Analyze the connections:**

The condition "no connecting line segment dissects either of the two triangles" means the line segment should not pass through the interior of the triangles (it can touch the vertices, but not cross through the middle or along an edge).

*   **Connections from Vertex A (the tip of the left triangle):**

Since both triangles are aligned at the top, this is a straight horizontal line above both triangles (assuming they are aligned at the top as per the visual). Even if the vertical positions were slightly off, a line connecting two vertices generally does not pass through the interior of a convex polygon (triangle) unless a third vertex lies on the segment. Visually, the triangles are aligned, so this line is outside or on the top boundary. **(Valid)**
    *   **B to F (Right Bottom):** The line connects the top of the left triangle to the bottom of the right triangle. This line passes through the "empty space" between the vertical right edge of the left triangle and the left tip of the right triangle. It does not cross the interior of the Left Triangle (it connects two vertices on its boundary but goes away from the shape) and it does not cross the interior of the Right Triangle (it enters at the bottom vertex and goes away from the shape). **(Valid)**

The only connections that dissect a triangle are **$A \rightarrow E$** and **$A \rightarrow F$**, which both cut through the interior of the Left Triangle. The other $7$ connections are valid.
